verdict.rationale: SumUp documents real outbound webhooks: a callback URL is set via `return_url` at checkout creation, and failed deliveries are retried. The docs also say the system only notifies on checkout status changes, so this covers roughly the payment-completion part of the lifecycle. Missing for 10: refund event notifications, dispute/chargeback event notifications, distinct authorized vs captured events, account-level webhook subscription (registration is per checkout only), and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can subscribe to payment lifecycle events (authorized, captured, refunded, disputed) via webhooks to drive downstream automations

citations.quote: At this time our system only allows you to get notified about a status change for a checkout. To subscribe to an event, specify a `return_url` parameter upon checkout creation.
